findings.note: at that round's head a new meter test set the per-workflow limit but switched AI titles off, so it missed that the title call uses up the one-request allowance of the basic workflow; a meter test with titles on would fail at head and expose it (test file exists at the round head, not the mapped head)

the run-findings workflow's paid sends go round the harness counter, so its declared request count and the suite cap are not enforced; no Vitest test checked the meter at this head, and a unit test of the counter would fail on the base where the bypass exists

notes: Most MUSTs here are operational (run live, record, report) rather than code behaviour. Live tests run only with the live flag and are not Vitest-gate tests (tests/live is outside vitest.config include); names follow the template `${workflow.name}` under the describe title. The per-suite cap test has a computed title and was skipped. Finding 2b's test exists only at its round head f1c8ea5. Reports found as final messages in live-checks-review.jsonl and live-checks-rereview2.jsonl.
